title: Discovery & Alignment
description: We begin with deep-dive strategic workshops to analyze your business goals, target demographic, competitive market landscape, and project deliverables.

title: Strategy & Architecture
description: Our team outlines information architecture, user journeys, data flow diagrams, and selects optimal frontend and backend technologies for your application.

title: UI/UX & Visual Design
description: We design high-fidelity visual mockups, design tokens, micro-interactions, and dark/light themes tailored to resonate with your brand identity.

title: Agile Development
description: Our developers write clean, maintainable, pixel-perfect code following modern standards, implementing responsive layouts, API integrations, and smooth animations.

title: Testing & QA Optimization
description: Rigorous multi-device testing, cross-browser compatibility checks, accessibility audits, Core Web Vitals speed tuning, and security penetration testing.

title: Deployment & Launch
description: Seamless deployment to high-speed global CDNs (Vercel, AWS, Cloudflare), domain SSL configuration, environment variables, and analytics tracking setup.

title: Growth & Continuous Support
description: We don't leave after launch. We provide ongoing 24/7 technical maintenance, security monitoring, SEO keyword optimization, and continuous feature expansion.
